items.title: 68091_Joe Turner oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, made it with all of 'em.

ctx.x: With...uh, lessee...Dizzy, Roy Eldridge...uh, "Sweets" Edison and Clark Terry. Right?
Yeah, made it with all of 'em.
And then you took the same thing up an'...an' appeared at Monterey. Right?

items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: Joe Turner worked in there with me, too.

ctx.x: Yeah. Yeah, I went into Kelly's [Stables] with a small group. Joe Turner worked in there with me, too. We worked in there. And I worked in there with Billy for nine months...or four months or something. We worked there a long...I don't know exactly how long. But it was the only time that any owner ever gave the band a party, we stayed in there so long, you know, doing this good business for him. [April-October, 1940]
Then I went out to Chicago. Glaser sent me out to Chicago. Then it was pushing on to '41, and I went to the Capitol Lounge.
